purpose: Teach: ハブ/シューズ/マックス/サバ/鷹/樹脂/メダル/必修

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お父さんの仕事、空港のハブ整備って、聞いたよ、すごいよね、本当に。
lines.en: Riku—your dad does hub maintenance at the airport? That's amazing, seriously.
lines.style: Bright and curious, genuinely impressed. Leans forward slightly. Opens with energy, settles into real interest. No performance, just warmth.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。陸上競技用のシューズ、新しいの、買ってもらったぜ、桜、見せようか。
lines.en: Yeah. I got new track shoes—want me to show you?
lines.style: Casual enthusiasm without trying too hard. Natural lift on the offer. Slightly self-aware, testing if she's really interested or just being polite.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 部活の練習、マックスで、頑張ってるよね、リク、いつも、本当に、感心するよ。
lines.en: You work so hard at club practice, Riku. Like, every single time. I actually really admire that about you.
lines.style: Sincere underneath a soft tone. Slower pace on the compliment—not rushed. A slight catch, like she's being honest in a way she doesn't usually let people see.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 家庭科で、サバの味噌煮、作ったぞ、結構、美味しかった、自分でも、驚いた。
lines.en: Oh, and I made mackerel miso in home ec the other day. It actually turned out pretty good—even surprised myself.
lines.style: Light, almost offhand delivery. Quick shift in topic like he's deflecting from the compliment. Energy picks up slightly. A small, genuine laugh lives under the words.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 地学のテスト、鷹の生態、出てきたよ、リク、勉強したから、できたよ。
lines.en: I had this geology test and they asked about hawk ecology. I actually studied for it this time, so I did okay.
lines.style: Upbeat but grounded. Matter-of-fact confidence—no overselling. Warm energy without needing approval. Natural conversational rhythm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 美術部、樹脂を使った作品、文化祭、出すんだろ、桜、楽しみだぜ。
lines.en: Oh, by the way—the art club's doing this resin piece for the school festival. I'm pretty excited about it.
lines.style: Open, inviting tone. Genuine enthusiasm without overshadowing the moment. Slight pause before the payoff, like she wants him to care too.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、運動会で、金メダル、また、取ったんだろ、すごいよね、リク、本当に。
lines.en: You took gold at the sports day again though, didn't you? That's seriously impressive, Riku.
lines.style: Direct admiration, no hedging. Confident in the compliment. Quick rhythm, warm tone. Sounds like she's stated a fact, not asked for reassurance.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 高校の必修、数学、結構、ハードだぜ、お前、ついていけてる、桜?
lines.en: Required math is pretty brutal in high school, isn't it? Are you managing to keep up with it okay, Sakura?
lines.style: Lighter question, almost teasing but genuinely checking in. Slight dip in confidence—he's asking something that matters. Eye-contact level steady, not deflecting this time.
